import struct
data=open('a.out','rb').read()
# parse program headers
e_phoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,0x20)[0]
e_phentsize=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,0x36)[0]
e_phnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',data,0x38)[0]
tot=0; zeros=0
for i in range(e_phnum):
 off=e_phoff+i*e_phentsize
 p_type,p_flags,p_offset,p_vaddr,p_paddr,p_filesz,p_memsz,p_align=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',data,off)
 if p_type==1:
  seg=data[p_offset:p_offset+p_filesz]
  n=len(seg)//4
  z=sum(1 for j in range(n) if seg[j*4:j*4+4]==b'\0\0\0\0')
  print(hex(p_vaddr),hex(p_filesz),hex(p_memsz),'words',n,'zero',z)
  tot+=n; zeros+=z
print('total',tot,'zero',zeros,zeros/tot)
EOF

import struct
d=open('a.out','rb').read()
e_shoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,0x28)[0]; e_shentsize=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x3a)[0]; e_shnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x3c)[0]; e_shstrndx=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x3e)[0]
sh=[]
for i in range(e_shnum):
 o=e_shoff+i*e_shentsize
 name,typ,flags,addr,off,size,link,info,align,entsize=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ',d,o)
 sh.append((name,typ,flags,addr,off,size))
stroff=sh[e_shstrndx][4]
def nm(n):
 e=d.index(b'\0',stroff+n); return d[stroff+n:e].decode()
alloc=[]; tot=0
for name,typ,flags,addr,off,size in sh:
 if flags & 2 and typ != 8: # SHF_ALLOC, not NOBITS
  n=nm(name); alloc.append((n,addr,off,size)); tot+=size
  print(n,hex(addr),hex(off),hex(size))
print('alloc PROGBITS total bytes',hex(tot),'words',tot//4)
# segment filesz total
e_phoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',d,0x20)[0]; es=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x36)[0]; n=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,0x38)[0]
segt=0
for i in range(n):
 p=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',d,e_phoff+i*es)
 if p[0]==1: segt+=p[5]
print('segment filesz total',hex(segt),'words',segt//4,'ratio',tot/segt)
# count overlap words addresses
segwords=set(); 
for i in range(n):
 p=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',d,e_phoff+i*es)
 if p[0]==1:
  for j in range(p[5]//4): segwords.add(p[3]+j*4)
secwords=set()
for n,a,o,s in alloc:
 for j in range(s//4): secwords.add(a+j*4)
print('sec words',len(secwords),'seg words',len(segwords),'overlap',len(secwords&segwords),'ratio',len(secwords&segwords)/len(segwords))
EOF
